hooks.prompt: Evaluate whether this file change could expose secrets, weaken authentication, or leak sensitive data. If the change is dangerous, respond with BLOCK and explain why. If safe, respond with ALLOW.
hooks.if: Write(**/.env*) || Write(**/auth/**) || Write(**/credentials*) || Write(**/secrets*) || Edit(**/.env*) || Edit(**/auth/**) || Edit(**/credentials*) || Edit(**/secrets*)
